svg.title: Chiral DMI Boundary Canting and Natural Boundary Laws
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) the numerically solved Rohart-Thiaville chiral edge canting profile m_z(x) across an open nanostrip under 2A d_nu m + D[(n_hat x nu) x m] = 0 with decay length Delta = sqrt(A/K_eff), and (b) FDM fixed +z ghost closure versus FEM general normalized normal n_hat and all three natural DMI boundary laws.
svg.text: Solved 1D BVP (A=15 pJ/m, Keff=0.3 MJ/m3, L=80 nm)
